item: 1.32 — prompt suggestions: the CLI's guess at the next prompt shows as the message box's placeholder, marked 'Suggestion:', and Tab writes it in (2026-11-22)
branch: js/70-events.js case 'prompt_suggestion' → js/60-composer.js onPromptSuggestion / setSuggestion (placeholder 'Suggestion: <text>   (Tab to use)', one line, cut at 90 characters for display) · the Tab keydown on #input (empty box only: writes the whole suggestion, sends nothing) · cleared by setBusy(true) and clearLogUI; dropped when it arrives mid-turn
provenance: The prompt_suggestion frame is the CLI's own, copied from a stdio tape of 2026-11-22 (2.1.330, panel flags + initialize.promptSuggestions:true, haiku, the prompt 'List the files in this directory'): {type:'prompt_suggestion', suggestion:'show hidden files too', uuid, session_id}, 1.2 s after the turn's result. Measured the same day: 4 of 7 turns produced one with the field declared, 0 of 1 without it, 0 of 4 with promptSuggestionEnabled:false passed through --settings. The longer suggestion texts here are invented to exercise the display cut. Tab is a synthetic keydown on #input, which runs our handler (what is under test) but not the browser's own focus move. window.__bridge is wrapped around every Tab so a send would be seen; busy is flipped by hand for the mid-turn case and put back. NEGATIVE CONTROL RUN 2026-11-22 against the pre-change webview (the sandbox on 1c0b8ee, `typeof setSuggestion` 'undefined'): 14 passed / 11 failed — every DISCRIMINATING assert, plus the caret and length guards that need the text written.
